# YourSpace Wellbeing

> YourSpace Wellbeing is an online wellbeing platform from HerSpace London, a women-focused barre, Pilates and wellness studio in Parsons Green, Fulham (London SW6). It brings the studio's expert instructors, nutrition guidance and evidence-based health thinking to people wherever they are: on-demand at-home workout classes, personalised meal plans, specialist programmes, and a Health Claim Checker that tests health claims against peer-reviewed research.

YourSpace is open to everyone, not just HerSpace London studio members. HerSpace London Unlimited (H.E.R.) members get The Home Studio free.

## Programmes

- [The Home Studio](https://www.yourspacewellbeing.com/home-studio): on-demand classes to do at home with minimal kit, taught by HerSpace London instructors Nesse, Benji and Jaimee. Classes include Ritual (full-body strength, Pilates and stretch), Mat Pilates, BEND (slow strength flow), Sweat (barre-based cardio), Barre45, Express Barre and Stretch. £17.99/month with a 7-day free trial, or £160/year.
- [The Menu](https://www.yourspacewellbeing.com/meal-planner): personalised, protein-rich 7-day meal plans with batch cooking built in, tailored to your targets and dietary needs. £9.99/month. Not a substitute for a registered nutritionist; one-to-one nutrition consultations are available at HerSpace London.
- [Health Claim Checker](https://www.yourspacewellbeing.com/health-claim-checker): type any health, supplement or nutrition claim (for example "magnesium reduces anxiety") and get a verdict based on published science, weighting systematic reviews and randomised controlled trials above single studies. Free summary; a full evidence report is a small one-off fee. [How it works](https://www.yourspacewellbeing.com/health-claim-checker-how-it-works).
- [Specialist Programmes](https://www.yourspacewellbeing.com/specialist): focused programmes for specific bodies and life stages, including [Prehab](https://www.yourspacewellbeing.com/prehab) (injury-prevention stability training for runners, skiers, tennis players and cyclists) and [Restore](https://www.yourspacewellbeing.com/restore) (postnatal return to movement, pelvic floor and core rehab).
- [Sofa to Studio](https://www.yourspacewellbeing.com/sofa-to-studio): a 30-day beginner programme that builds strength and confidence at home before a first studio class.
- [Back to It Challenge](https://www.yourspacewellbeing.com/back-to-it): a free 4-week challenge of 4 classes a week at HerSpace London, with prizes.

## Related

- [HerSpace London](https://www.herspaceldn.com/): the in-person studio in Parsons Green, Fulham, offering barre, reformer and mat Pilates, personal training, nutrition consultations and skin treatments.
- [Wine & Wellness Retreat](https://innamo.travel/retreat): an annual retreat in Tuscany, run with Innamo Travel.
